name: ai-architect-mcp-spec
description: Cross-platform PRD verifier and host-driven generator with deterministic structural rules, calibrated multi-judge verification, and full audit lineage. 17 MCP tools, 1504 tests.

scripts.bundle: esbuild packages/mcp-server/dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=mcp-server/index.js && node scripts/stamp-bundle-version.mjs && chmod +x mcp-server/index.js
scripts.verify: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm bundle && pnpm test

auditConfig.//: Issue #36: the ignore list is EMPTY and stays empty. Every GHSA it used to carry now has a published fix pinned in `pnpm.overrides`, so `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` blocks on real findings only. The former rationale claimed mathjs was 'absent from the shipped .mcpb' — that was false: `grep -c mathjs mcp-server/index.js` returns 709 on the bundle it described, so the 2-major bump was owed, not optional. Every override floor is the `first_patched_version` GitHub's advisory API reports for that GHSA, and each satisfies its declaring parent's own range (see SECURITY.md). Add an entry here only when an advisory has NO published fix, and only with the reproduction that shows it.
